Star score calibration — blind grading deck

Grade each chart 1–5 the way you would on stream, before revealing. The score, its eight dimensions and what price actually did next are all hidden until you click reveal. Where you and the score disagree is the output of this ticket.

On the chart: blue bands = the retained valid windows (darker = the primary, shortest window) · dashed blue = §3.2's fitted triangle · gold = trigger · red dashes = estimated stop (base low) · MAs: 10 20 50 65 EMA.
